problems.title: 1–2–3 conjecture
problems.statement: Can edges of every connected graph with at least three vertices be weighted 1, 2, or 3 so adjacent vertices have different weighted degrees?

ratings.rationale: Three allowed weights are near known bounds; final step is still open.

problems.title: Andrica conjecture
problems.statement: Is the difference between the square roots of consecutive primes always less than 1?

ratings.rationale: Needs prime-gap bounds beyond the current unconditional range.

problems.title: Artin primitive root conjecture
problems.statement: Is every integer other than -1 and a perfect square a primitive root modulo infinitely many primes?

ratings.rationale: Primitive-root distribution requires deep analytic number theory.

problems.title: Bateman–Horn conjecture
problems.statement: Does the predicted asymptotic count of simultaneous prime values of admissible polynomials hold?

ratings.rationale: Precise prime-value asymptotics for polynomial systems are far beyond reach.

problems.title: Beal conjecture
problems.statement: If A^x + B^y = C^z for positive integers and exponents greater than 2, must A, B, and C share a prime factor?

ratings.rationale: Generalized Fermat equations likely need stronger modular methods.

problems.title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture
problems.statement: Does the rank of an elliptic curve over the rationals equal the order of vanishing of its L-function at 1?

ratings.rationale: Millennium-scale conjecture linking ranks and L-functions.

problems.title: Bloch–Beilinson conjectures
problems.statement: Does the predicted filtration on Chow groups with its expected motivic properties exist?

ratings.rationale: Large conjectural filtration framework needs foundational advances.

problems.title: Brocard problem
problems.statement: Characterize all integer solutions of n!+1=m².

ratings.rationale: Elementary statement with only a few known solutions; exclusion is hard.

problems.title: Brualdi–Stein conjecture
problems.statement: Does every Latin square of even order have a partial transversal of size n-1?

ratings.rationale: The near-transversal bound is close to partial results but not general.

problems.title: Bunyakovsky conjecture
problems.statement: Does every irreducible integer polynomial with positive leading coefficient and no fixed prime divisor take infinitely many prime values?

ratings.rationale: General prime-producing polynomial theorem needs major sieve advances.

problems.title: Caccetta–Häggkvist conjecture
problems.statement: Does every n-vertex digraph with minimum outdegree at least r contain a directed cycle of length at most ceil(n/r)?

ratings.rationale: The directed-girth bound is difficult across all degree regimes.

problems.title: Carmichael totient conjecture
problems.statement: Is there no positive integer n for which Euler's totient equation φ(x)=n has exactly one solution?

ratings.rationale: Totient multiplicities remain difficult to classify globally.

problems.title: Chowla conjecture
problems.statement: Do products of the Liouville function at distinct shifts exhibit asymptotic cancellation?

ratings.rationale: Full correlations of multiplicative functions remain open.

problems.title: Collatz conjecture
problems.statement: Does repeated application of n/2 for even n and 3n+1 for odd n reach 1 for every positive integer?

ratings.rationale: Simple dynamics conceal a difficult global termination question.

problems.title: Conway thrackle conjecture
problems.statement: Can a drawing in which every pair of edges meets exactly once have more edges than vertices?

ratings.rationale: A simple-sounding drawing bound hides nontrivial topological cases.

problems.title: Cycle double cover conjecture
problems.statement: Does every bridgeless finite graph admit a collection of cycles covering each edge exactly twice?

ratings.rationale: A universal cycle cover for bridgeless graphs requires deeper structure.

problems.title: Dixmier conjecture
problems.statement: Is every endomorphism of a Weyl algebra an automorphism?

ratings.rationale: Equivalent in difficulty to the Jacobian conjecture; broad algebraic obstruction.

problems.title: Eleven-eighths conjecture
problems.statement: Does every smooth closed spin four-manifold satisfy the proposed 11/8 bound on its intersection form?

ratings.rationale: Smooth four-manifold constraints remain far from the proposed bound.

problems.title: Erdős unit distance problem
problems.statement: What is the maximum number of unit-distance pairs among n points in the plane?

ratings.rationale: Sharp extremal unit-distance bounds need stronger incidence techniques.

problems.title: Erdős–Hajnal conjecture
problems.statement: Does forbidding any fixed induced subgraph force a polynomial-size clique or independent set?

ratings.rationale: A polynomial homogeneous-set bound needs new induced-subgraph theory.

problems.title: Erdős–Moser equation
problems.statement: Is 1^k + 2^k + ... + (m-1)^k = m^k possible for integers m greater than 1 and k greater than 1?

ratings.rationale: High-power sum equation needs stronger global exclusion bounds.

problems.title: Erdős–Straus conjecture
problems.statement: Can 4/n be written as 1/x + 1/y + 1/z in positive integers for every n at least 2?

ratings.rationale: Many cases verified; a uniform Egyptian-fraction argument is missing.

problems.title: Erdős–Szekeres convex polygon conjecture
problems.statement: Is the minimum number of general-position planar points forcing a convex n-gon equal to 2^(n-2)+1?

ratings.rationale: Exact convex-polygon thresholds need sharper extremal configurations.

problems.title: Erdős–Ulam problem
problems.statement: Is there a dense subset of the Euclidean plane whose pairwise distances are all rational?

ratings.rationale: Dense rational-distance structure would require major arithmetic-geometric insight.

problems.title: Falconer distance conjecture
problems.statement: Does a planar set of Hausdorff dimension greater than 1 have a distance set of positive measure?

ratings.rationale: The endpoint distance-set threshold resists present geometric measure methods.

problems.title: Fermat–Catalan conjecture
problems.statement: Are there only finitely many distinct triples of powers (x^p,y^q,z^r) from coprime positive integers x,y,z satisfying x^p+y^q=z^r, with p,q,r greater than 1 and 1/p+1/q+1/r less than 1?

ratings.rationale: Requires uniform control across infinitely many generalized Fermat signatures.

problems.title: Fontaine–Mazur conjecture
problems.statement: Do geometric p-adic Galois representations come from the expected arithmetic constructions?

ratings.rationale: General classification of geometric Galois representations is far-reaching.

problems.title: Four exponentials conjecture
problems.statement: For two rationally linearly independent pairs x₁,x₂ and y₁,y₂, must at least one of the four numbers exp(xᵢyⱼ) be transcendental?

ratings.rationale: Core transcendence conjecture exceeds current exponential methods.

problems.title: Generalized Riemann hypothesis
problems.statement: Do all nontrivial zeros of every Dirichlet L-function have real part 1/2?

ratings.rationale: Extends RH across Dirichlet L-functions; broad new methods likely.

problems.title: Goldbach conjecture
problems.statement: Is every even integer greater than 2 a sum of two primes?

ratings.rationale: Additive prime representation resists current sieve techniques.

problems.title: Graceful tree conjecture
problems.statement: Does every finite tree admit a graceful labeling?

ratings.rationale: A constructive labeling for every tree has resisted many special cases.

problems.title: Graph isomorphism in P
problems.statement: Is graph isomorphism decidable in deterministic polynomial time?

ratings.rationale: Quasipolynomial algorithms do not yet give a polynomial-time bound.

problems.title: Graph reconstruction conjecture
problems.statement: Is every finite simple graph with at least three vertices determined by its vertex-deleted subgraphs?

ratings.rationale: Reconstruction across all finite graphs needs a new global method.

problems.title: Grothendieck period conjecture
problems.statement: Are all algebraic relations among periods explained by algebraic geometry?

ratings.rationale: Would explain all period relations through algebraic geometry.

problems.title: Grothendieck section conjecture
problems.statement: Do rational points on a hyperbolic curve correspond exactly to sections of its arithmetic fundamental group?

ratings.rationale: Bridges rational points and anabelian fundamental groups in full generality.

problems.title: Gyárfás–Sumner conjecture
problems.statement: For every tree T and integer k, do T-free graphs of bounded clique number have bounded chromatic number?

ratings.rationale: The full tree-forbidding chromatic bound remains unresolved.

problems.title: Hadamard matrix conjecture
problems.statement: Does a Hadamard matrix exist for every positive order divisible by 4?

ratings.rationale: Uniform constructions for every multiple of four remain unknown.

problems.title: Hadwiger conjecture
problems.statement: Does every graph with no K_(t+1) minor admit a proper t-coloring?

ratings.rationale: General graph-minor coloring extends far beyond settled small cases.

problems.title: Hadwiger–Nelson problem
problems.statement: What is the exact chromatic number of the Euclidean plane when points at unit distance need different colors?

ratings.rationale: Sharp plane coloring bounds are close but need a decisive construction or obstruction.

problems.title: Harary–Hill crossing number conjecture
problems.statement: Does the standard formula give the crossing number of every complete graph K_n?

ratings.rationale: The standard crossing formula is hard to prove for all complete graphs.

problems.title: Higher-dimensional Kakeya conjecture
problems.statement: Must every Kakeya set in Euclidean dimension at least 4 have full Hausdorff dimension?

ratings.rationale: Higher-dimensional Kakeya geometry likely needs new incidence or analytic tools.

problems.title: Hilbert's tenth problem over Q
problems.statement: Is there an algorithm deciding whether an arbitrary polynomial equation over Q has a rational solution?

ratings.rationale: The rational decision problem has resisted all known undecidability methods.

problems.title: Hodge conjecture
problems.statement: Is every rational Hodge class on a smooth projective complex variety a rational combination of algebraic cycles?

ratings.rationale: Millennium-scale algebraic-cycle classification needs new tools.

problems.title: Hopf sign conjecture
problems.statement: Does every closed nonpositively curved even-dimensional manifold have Euler characteristic with the predicted sign?

ratings.rationale: Curvature-sign control in all even dimensions remains structurally difficult.

problems.title: Illumination conjecture
problems.statement: Can every convex body in dimension d be illuminated by at most 2^d directions?

ratings.rationale: A dimension-uniform illumination bound remains beyond current approaches.

problems.title: Infinitely many Fermat primes
problems.statement: Are there infinitely many primes of the form 2 to the (2 to the n) plus 1?

ratings.rationale: Extremely sparse sequence; even the expected answer is uncertain.

problems.title: Infinitely many Mersenne primes
problems.statement: Are there infinitely many primes of the form 2 to the n minus 1?

ratings.rationale: Very sparse exponential sequence frustrates standard prime tools.

problems.title: Infinitely many Sophie Germain primes
problems.statement: Are there infinitely many primes p for which 2p+1 is also prime?

ratings.rationale: Prime pair pattern remains beyond current prime-value methods.

problems.title: Inverse Galois problem
problems.statement: Can every finite group occur as a Galois group over the rational numbers?

ratings.rationale: Would construct all finite groups as Galois groups over Q.

problems.title: Irrationality of Catalan's constant
problems.statement: Is Catalan's constant irrational?

ratings.rationale: Even irrationality is unknown; present methods give limited bounds.

problems.title: Irrationality of Euler's constant
problems.statement: Is the Euler–Mascheroni constant irrational?

ratings.rationale: Even irrationality is unknown despite extensive analytic study.

problems.title: Jacobian conjecture
problems.statement: Is every polynomial self-map of complex affine space with constant nonzero Jacobian determinant invertible by polynomials?

ratings.rationale: Simple polynomial formulation, but no general inversion proof is known.

problems.title: Kummer–Vandiver conjecture
problems.statement: Does p never divide the class number of the maximal real subfield of the p-th cyclotomic field?

ratings.rationale: General cyclotomic class-number nondivisibility is very difficult.

problems.title: Kurepa hypothesis
problems.statement: For every odd prime p, is the left factorial !p nonzero modulo p?

ratings.rationale: Factorial congruences resist a proof across all odd primes.

problems.title: Langlands functoriality conjecture
problems.statement: Do the predicted transfers of automorphic representations for L-group maps exist in general?

ratings.rationale: Central unifying transfer principle across automorphic representation theory.

problems.title: Lebesgue universal covering problem
problems.statement: What is the smallest-area convex shape that can contain every planar set of diameter 1 after a rigid motion?

ratings.rationale: Optimizing the universal cover is difficult but geometrically concrete.

problems.title: Legendre conjecture
problems.statement: Is there a prime strictly between n squared and (n+1) squared for every positive integer n?

ratings.rationale: Requires prime control in intervals shorter than established bounds.

problems.title: Lehmer tau conjecture
problems.statement: Is Ramanujan's tau function nonzero at every positive integer?

ratings.rationale: Nonvanishing of all tau coefficients requires deep modular-form insight.

problems.title: Lehmer totient problem
problems.statement: If φ(n) divides n-1, must n be prime?

ratings.rationale: Would rule out composite totient divisibility exceptions.

problems.title: Leopoldt conjecture
problems.statement: Does the p-adic regulator of every number field have the expected nonzero rank?

ratings.rationale: p-adic regulator nonvanishing over all number fields needs new insight.

problems.title: Lindelöf hypothesis
problems.statement: Does the zeta function grow more slowly than every positive power along the critical line?

ratings.rationale: Critical-line growth control is closely tied to RH.

problems.title: List edge coloring conjecture
problems.statement: Does the list chromatic index of every graph equal its chromatic index?

ratings.rationale: List constraints make a universal edge-coloring equality difficult.

problems.title: Littlewood conjecture
problems.statement: For all real α and β, is inf over n≥1 of n·||nα||·||nβ|| equal to zero, where ||x|| is the distance to the nearest integer?

ratings.rationale: Simultaneous Diophantine approximation remains resistant in full generality.

problems.title: Log-rank conjecture
problems.statement: Is deterministic communication complexity polynomially bounded by the logarithm of a sign matrix's rank?

ratings.rationale: The proposed rank relation needs new communication-complexity tools.

problems.title: Mahler conjecture
problems.statement: Do the conjectured extremal convex bodies minimize the volume product among centrally symmetric convex bodies?

ratings.rationale: General convex body extremality likely requires new geometric methods.

problems.title: Matrix multiplication exponent
problems.statement: Is the exponent of square matrix multiplication equal to 2?

ratings.rationale: Proving exponent two demands fundamentally stronger multiplication algorithms.

problems.title: Montgomery pair correlation conjecture
problems.statement: Do the normalized spacings of nontrivial zeta zeros obey the predicted pair correlation law?

ratings.rationale: Fine zero-spacing statistics require new spectral or analytic methods.

problems.title: NP versus coNP
problems.statement: Are NP and coNP distinct complexity classes?

ratings.rationale: A separation would require major circuit or proof-complexity advances.

problems.title: Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness
problems.statement: Do smooth divergence-free initial data in three dimensions always yield global smooth Navier–Stokes solutions?

ratings.rationale: A Millennium Prize problem with a fundamental three-dimensional regularity gap.

problems.title: Novikov conjecture
problems.statement: Are higher signatures of closed oriented manifolds invariant under oriented homotopy equivalence?

ratings.rationale: The full conjecture spans general groups beyond proved cases.

problems.title: Odd perfect number problem
problems.statement: Does an odd perfect number exist?

ratings.rationale: Deep divisibility bounds exist, but existence remains unresolved.

problems.title: Oppermann conjecture
problems.statement: Does each half of the interval between consecutive squares contain a prime?

ratings.rationale: Strengthens prime-between-squares estimates in two subintervals.

problems.title: P versus NP
problems.statement: Can every problem whose solution is efficiently verified also be efficiently solved?

ratings.rationale: Separating polynomial-time verification from solution is a foundational barrier.

problems.title: Polignac conjecture
problems.statement: Does every positive even integer occur infinitely often as a gap between consecutive primes?

ratings.rationale: Requires every even prime gap to recur infinitely often.

problems.title: Prime k-tuple conjecture
problems.statement: Does every admissible finite pattern of prime offsets occur infinitely often?

ratings.rationale: General admissible prime patterns need stronger sieve tools.

problems.title: Riemann hypothesis
problems.statement: Do all nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2?

ratings.rationale: Foundational analytic-number-theory barrier; likely requires new methods.

problems.title: Ryser conjecture on Latin squares
problems.statement: Does every Latin square of odd order have a transversal?

ratings.rationale: A transversal in every odd Latin square needs a uniform combinatorial proof.

problems.title: Sarnak Möbius disjointness conjecture
problems.statement: Is the Möbius function asymptotically orthogonal to every zero-entropy dynamical system?

ratings.rationale: Uniform Möbius orthogonality across zero-entropy dynamics is broad.

problems.title: Schanuel conjecture
problems.statement: Does every rationally linearly independent tuple of complex numbers satisfy Schanuel's transcendence-degree bound?

ratings.rationale: Sweeping transcendence statement would require fundamentally new tools.

problems.title: Schinzel hypothesis H
problems.statement: Do compatible irreducible integer polynomials simultaneously take prime values infinitely often?

ratings.rationale: Unifies simultaneous prime values; new general machinery likely.

problems.title: Sidorenko conjecture
problems.statement: Does every bipartite graph satisfy the predicted lower bound on homomorphism density?

ratings.rationale: Universal bipartite homomorphism inequalities need a broad proof technique.

problems.title: Singer conjecture
problems.statement: Does an aspherical closed manifold have L²-Betti numbers concentrated in its middle dimension?

ratings.rationale: General aspherical manifolds require stronger L² and geometric topology tools.

problems.title: Slice–ribbon conjecture
problems.statement: Is every slice knot a ribbon knot?

ratings.rationale: Known knot invariants do not settle all slice knots.

problems.title: Smooth four-dimensional Poincaré conjecture
problems.statement: Is every smooth four-manifold homeomorphic to the four-sphere also diffeomorphic to it?

ratings.rationale: Smooth four-dimensional classification has deep unresolved obstructions.

problems.title: Smooth four-dimensional Schoenflies conjecture
problems.statement: Does every smoothly embedded three-sphere in the four-sphere bound a standard smooth four-ball on each side?

ratings.rationale: Smooth embedding and four-ball issues are central four-dimensional barriers.

problems.title: Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles
problems.statement: Do Grothendieck's expected positivity and Lefschetz properties for algebraic cycles hold?

ratings.rationale: Several foundational motivic positivity statements remain unresolved.

problems.title: Sunflower conjecture
problems.statement: For each fixed petal count m, is there a constant Cₘ such that more than Cₘ^k distinct k-element sets force an m-sunflower?

ratings.rationale: Exponential sunflower thresholds need stronger set-system techniques.

problems.title: Tate conjecture
problems.statement: Are suitable Galois-invariant cohomology classes generated by algebraic cycles?

ratings.rationale: Broad finite-field analog of Hodge-type cycle questions.

problems.title: Three-dimensional Euler blowup problem
problems.statement: Can smooth initial data for the three-dimensional incompressible Euler equations develop a finite-time singularity?

ratings.rationale: Finite-time Euler singularity remains a core unsolved PDE question.

problems.title: Total coloring conjecture
problems.statement: Is the total chromatic number of every graph at most its maximum degree plus 2?

ratings.rationale: Closing the last color gap for all graphs requires a general argument.

problems.title: Tutte five-flow conjecture
problems.statement: Does every bridgeless finite graph have a nowhere-zero 5-flow?

ratings.rationale: The 5-flow bound is close to known flow results but remains open.

problems.title: Tutte three-flow conjecture
problems.statement: Does every 4-edge-connected finite graph have a nowhere-zero 3-flow?

ratings.rationale: The 3-flow claim is substantially stronger than known general bounds.

problems.title: Twin prime conjecture
problems.statement: Are there infinitely many pairs of primes differing by 2?

ratings.rationale: Bounded gaps are known, but reducing the gap to two remains hard.

problems.title: Union-closed sets conjecture
problems.statement: Does every finite union-closed family containing at least one nonempty set have an element in at least half of its sets?

ratings.rationale: A universal half-frequency argument still eludes partial advances.

problems.title: Unique games conjecture
problems.statement: Is it NP-hard to distinguish nearly satisfiable from highly unsatisfiable unique games?

ratings.rationale: A full hardness proof would reshape approximation complexity.

problems.title: VP versus VNP
problems.statement: Are the algebraic complexity classes VP and VNP distinct?

ratings.rationale: Algebraic complexity separation is a major lower-bound frontier.

problems.title: Volume conjecture for knots
problems.statement: Does the asymptotic growth of colored Jones polynomials recover hyperbolic knot volume?

ratings.rationale: Connecting quantum invariants to volume uniformly needs new arguments.

problems.title: Yang–Mills existence and mass gap
problems.statement: Can a nontrivial quantum Yang–Mills theory on four-dimensional space be constructed rigorously with a positive mass gap?

ratings.rationale: Rigorous four-dimensional quantum field construction and a mass gap need new tools.

problems.title: Zarankiewicz crossing number conjecture
problems.statement: Does the standard Zarankiewicz formula give the crossing number of every complete bipartite graph K_(m,n)?

ratings.rationale: Complete bipartite crossing numbers remain difficult in general.

problems.title: Zaremba conjecture
problems.statement: Is there a universal bound A such that every positive integer is the denominator of a reduced fraction whose continued-fraction coefficients are at most A?

ratings.rationale: Known density results do not yet cover every denominator.
